name: Kochkurs 'Tiroler Klassiker'
beschreibung:
=== description ===
Join a top chef to prepare some of the most famous Tyrolean dishes: **Tyrolean Knödel** in three variations, **Zillertal Krapfen**, and of course, the classic **Kaiserschmarrn**. The course covers traditional techniques and regional ingredient knowledge. Afterward, you’ll enjoy the meal together in a cozy setting, complete with a complementary wine pairing.
